events.title: Safari 8 released
events.summary: Apple released Safari 8 on October 16, 2014 with OS X Yosemite — adding WebGL improvements, Tab View, and DuckDuckGo as a search option.
events.about: Safari 8 refined the Yosemite design language with translucent UI and tighter iCloud integration. WebGL and IndexedDB improvements kept pace with Chrome for casual gaming and offline apps on Mac.

narrative.whyChosen: Safari 8 paired with Yosemite's visual redesign and continuity features.
narrative.whyImportant: Tab View and iCloud tabs deepened cross-device browsing on Apple hardware.
narrative.problemSolved: Mac users wanted Safari to feel as modern as the redesigned OS X Yosemite.

sources.title: Apple — OS X Yosemite available today (October 16, 2014)
